capabilities: sync snips with transcripts, notes and AI summaries into the vault
attach podcast metadata like image, title and publish date
customize episode filename, episode and snip templates
expose metadata as properties for Obsidian Bases views
connect to a Snipd account via browser sign-in
extras: The default snip template embeds Snipd's audio player from share.snipd.com, which loads on note open; remove {{snip_audio_player}} to avoid it. Requires a Snipd account (free, created via the mobile app); sign-in must happen in a native browser, not Obsidian's in-app browser.
intentEvidence: The official Snipd plugin maintained by the Snipd team
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull podcast highlights, transcripts and episode metadata from the Snipd service into notes.

relations.evidence: the plugin connects only to the Snipd API (api.snipd.com), to link your account and to download your snips

summary: Official Snipd plugin that syncs podcast highlights (snips) into the vault with transcripts, notes, AI summaries and podcast metadata.
